mg.title: A unique example

text.main: a unique example of young people participating within the peace process

mg.use: Over Christos as he says it, before you cut to the cards.

mg.use: Brackets on the three white cards in the B-roll. Move them to where the cards sit.

mg.title: Trust-building that worked

text.main: one of the most successful trust-building measures implemented in the Cypriot problem.
